title: Earth wire (asset overlay)
description: Phase 5a asset overlay kind. The overhead earth wire (shield wire) of a line route. Carried beside the model, never used by the solver: the line's zero-sequence values r0Pu and x0Pu stay the authored ones.

count.description: Number of earth wires strung on the route.

bondedAtBothEnds.description: True when the earth wire is bonded to the station earth at both ends.
